Words Do Not Wait Until the Sentence Is Finished――ことばは勝手に出てくるのか

文章を書いていると、words sometimes seem to arrive by themselves. Psycholinguistic research suggests that speakers do not always formulate an entire sentence before starting; language production unfolds incrementally. Writing research, however, also shows that planning, goal setting, strategy instruction, models and revision can improve writing. だから文章術は『言葉を無から生む方法』というより、材料を蓄え、方向を与え、出てきた言葉を選び直す技術なのかもしれない。
